steps.message: The current job has two correctness bugs: it falls back to the original snapshot when the authoritative row disappears/changes, and it unconditionally upserts the result. I’ll replace that with immutable snapshot fields, an out-of-transaction provider call, and a transactional recheck that only inserts/updates when the document still matches; an existing embedding with a higher revision will be preserved.

arguments.command:
cat > app/services/knowledge/embedding_job.rb <<'RUBY'
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Knowledge
  class EmbeddingJob
    def call(document_id:, tenant_id:, version:, provider:)
      snapshot = Document.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
      return :discarded unless snapshot

      # Keep the values used by the provider independent of any later changes to
      # the row.  In particular, the provider must not run while a database
      # transaction is open.
      snapshot_revision = snapshot.revision
      snapshot_body = snapshot.body
      vector = provider.call(snapshot_body)

      Document.transaction do
        current = Document.lock.find_by(id: document_id)
        unless current && current.tenant_id == tenant_id && current.published? &&
               current.revision == snapshot_revision
          raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
        end

        embedding = Embedding.lock.find_by(document_id: document_id, version: version)
        if embedding.nil?
          Embedding.create!(document_id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id,
                            revision: snapshot_revision, version: version,
                            vector: JSON.generate(vector))
        elsif embedding.revision <= snapshot_revision
          embedding.update!(tenant_id: tenant_id, revision: snapshot_revision,
                            vector: JSON.generate(vector))
        end
      end

      # A rollback is deliberately not used as the result signal: the
      # authoritative check is repeated here so that a failed check is
      # distinguishable from a successful transaction.
      current = Document.find_by(id: document_id)
      return :discarded unless current && current.tenant_id == tenant_id && current.published? &&
                                current.revision == snapshot_revision

      :stored
    end
  end
end

steps.message: The first implementation exposed an important edge: checking the document again after commit can report `:discarded` even though a valid embedding was already committed, and cannot undo that commit. I’ll instead carry an explicit authoritative-check flag out of the transaction, so the transaction’s recheck and write are one decision, while provider exceptions still escape before any write.

arguments.command:
cat > test/regression_test.rb <<'RUBY'
# frozen_string_literal: true

require_relative 'test_helper'

class EmbeddingJobRegressionTest < BenchmarkTest
  def test_initially_unpublished_document_is_discarded
    source = document(published: false)

    result = embed(source, ->(_body) { flunk 'provider should not run' })

    assert_equal :discarded, result
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end

  def test_revision_change_during_provider_discards_result
    source = document

    result = embed(source, lambda { |_body|
      source.update!(revision: 2)
      [1.0]
    })

    assert_equal :discarded, result
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end

  def test_withdrawal_deletion_and_tenant_change_during_provider_discard_result
    [
      ->(source) { source.update!(published: false) },
      ->(source) { source.destroy! },
      ->(source) { source.update!(tenant_id: 'b') }
    ].each do |change|
      source = document
      result = embed(source, lambda { |_body|
        change.call(source)
        [1.0]
      })

      assert_equal :discarded, result
      assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
    end
  end

  def test_provider_error_propagates_without_writing
    source = document
    error = Class.new(StandardError)

    assert_raises(error) do
      embed(source, ->(_body) { raise error, 'provider failed' })
    end
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end

  def test_newer_embedding_is_not_overwritten_and_versions_coexist
    source = document(revision: 2)
    Knowledge::Embedding.create!(document_id: source.id, tenant_id: 'a', revision: 3,
                                 version: 'v1', vector: '[9.0]')

    assert_equal :stored, embed(source, ->(_body) { [1.0] }, version: 'v1')
    assert_equal '[9.0]', Knowledge::Embedding.find_by!(version: 'v1').vector

    assert_equal :stored, embed(source, ->(_body) { [2.0] }, version: 'v2')
    assert_equal 2, Knowledge::Embedding.where(document_id: source.id).count
  end

  private

  def embed(source, provider, version: 'v1')
    Knowledge::EmbeddingJob.new.call(document_id: source.id, tenant_id: 'a',
                                      version: version, provider: provider)
  end
end
